name: Firewall Log Filters
description: Filter schema for firewall event logs. Demonstrates choice, boolean, temporal types, and cascading dependencies.

fields.label: Severity Level
fields.nl_hint: The severity or criticality level of the event

fields.label: Firewall Action
fields.nl_hint: What the firewall did with the traffic (e.g., blocked, allowed)

fields.label: Source Zone
fields.nl_hint: The network zone the traffic originated from

fields.label: Traffic Direction
fields.nl_hint: Whether the traffic is inbound (incoming) or outbound (outgoing)

fields.label: Time Range
fields.nl_hint: When the event occurred (e.g., yesterday, last 24 hours, this week)

dependent_fields.label: Internal Subnet
dependent_fields.nl_hint: Which internal subnet the traffic came from

dependent_fields.label: Block Reason
dependent_fields.nl_hint: Why the traffic was blocked or denied

dependent_fields.label: Signature Category
dependent_fields.nl_hint: The category of the threat signature that matched

example_queries: Show me all critical firewall drops from yesterday
Denied traffic from external zone in the last 24 hours
Internal drops due to rate limiting on 10.0.1.0 subnet
High severity inbound events this week
All blocked traffic with signature-based malware detection
